title: Take a fresh durability ticket for a response chunk after its head

contract.intent: Take a fresh durability ticket for a response chunk after its head
preconditions: Fresh State::new("fixture", config) in this test only; no direct State field mutation
Initial config is fully pinned in profile.json; actual celld-logic::on_event is the only transition
For each resident: RequestAt -> OwnerRead (absent or exact prior local epoch) -> OwnerCasCompleted Applied -> RestoreCompleted -> RuntimeStarted generation1 -> Published; expect Local and exact epoch
Every real completion operation ID is captured from an exact emitted effect; G017 deliberately supplies gate+1000 as an unknown-op negative control. Every transition calls State::validate
No actual clock, I/O, runtime, object store, host credentials, or external traffic; source/pin/toolchain preflight required
contract.oracle: Head immediate; second ticket held through bucket proof; writer and chunk release only after ownership; next proven chunk immediate
contract.cleanup: Finish explicit request activities/reset/runtime transitions shown in test. Drop the test-owned State at return or unwind; all state is in-memory and isolated. No production resource is created. Runner reaps only its owned compiler/test process groups and preserves evidence.
